scope: Dashboard Next: Solid + Vite + TypeScript full rewrite of the Rust Astrbot dashboard, restoring AstrBot Vue 3 parity and deleting the legacy dashboard/ directory.
strategy: One-shot rewrite. Backend management/* HTTP contract is frozen during the rewrite (only ts-rs derives are added). DTOs flow Rust -> TS via ts-rs with a CI drift check. Hash routing is preserved to keep DASHBOARD_INDEX_ROUTES SPA fallback compatible. Legacy dashboard/ directory is removed before TASK-001 implementation begins.
ordering_rationale: TASK-001 first lands the scaffold, DTO codegen pipeline, and runtime NextDist plumbing so every later phase has a working frontend toolchain. Foundation layers (AppShell/auth/components) precede surface pages so we don't repeat shell setup. Read-only pages (Phase 2) come before write-heavy schema-driven forms (Phase 3) because they exercise the data layer without mutation risk. Conversation flow (Phase 4) is intentionally before extension ecosystem (Phase 5) so we validate the message-part renderer early. Knowledge base, persona, ops, and new endpoints follow in priority order. Phase 9 is the cleanup gate that flips NextDist to the default and verifies bundle/e2e budgets.
